describe.chat: Show what the voice will say aloud, before you guess a pronunciation. For slides (`from`, optional `to`, up to {{PREVIEW_SPEECH_MAX_SLIDES}} at a time) it reads each slide the way Present and the export do: its spoken line (say:) first, then a front-matter say: entry, then chart narration, then the slide text. It names which one it read, lists each deck term that fired as written → as spoken (a possessive or plural is listed on its own), and lists words no term covers that a voice may stumble on (all-caps runs, a dot inside a word, odd capitals; names from other languages are not detected). Speaker notes are never read aloud. Or pass `text` to hear any words, for example a term before you add it with set_terms.

text.description: Any words to hear instead of slides.
